blocks.content: B+ trees are a variation of B-trees. So, before looking at the actual structure of a B+ tree, we need to discuss two shortcomings of B-trees:

items: Difficulty in finding sequential data in a range.
Choosing the appropriate degree for the appropriate height and width.
